**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

Each resumed invocation takes a fresh wall anchor, while reset discards the previous boundary. A backward clock adjustment—or sub-millisecond re-anchoring—can therefore make the terminal `Workflow` and `DurableExecutionRoot` end before an invocation already exported by the same warm plugin instance. Retain a monotonic high-water boundary across invocation resets and clamp terminal root ends to it; mirror this in `ExecutionOtelPlugin` and assert containment for the negative-wall-step same-plugin case.
